allOf.description: Structured frequency-cap constraints. Count and duration declarations are exact: each uses either an exhaustive preset list or an inclusive range, never a unit-only promise. At product scope, omitted fields inherit the applicable seller-wide capability and never broaden it. Product mutability describes implementation capability; MediaBuy.available_actions remains authoritative for a live buy.

max_impressions_constraints.description: Exact supported max_impressions presets or range.
max_impressions_constraints.title: Frequency Cap Impression Constraints

x-adcp-validation.ordered_bounds: minimum MUST be less than or equal to maximum.

mutable_fields.description: Logical cap fields that can change after creation. An empty array means create-only. For example, [max_impressions] permits changing the count while keeping per and window fixed. Omission means update support is undeclared and the legacy broad meaning applies.

items.description: A logical frequency-cap field that a product implementation can change after creation. suppress covers the effective cooldown whether represented by suppress or the deprecated suppress_minutes alias.
items.title: Frequency Cap Mutable Field

supported_control_modes.description: FrequencyCap shapes accepted by the product. max_impressions_and_suppress means both controls may appear together and are enforced with AND semantics.

items.description: A supported package frequency-cap control shape.
items.title: Frequency Cap Control Mode

supported_per_units.description: Entity granularities accepted by max_impressions caps.

items.description: Unit of measurement for reach and audience size metrics. Different channels and measurement providers count reach in fundamentally different units, making cross-channel comparison impossible without declaring the unit.

enumDescriptions.custom: Seller-defined reach unit. Describe in ext. For a Product.identity declaration with persistent_identifier false, describe the unit in Product.identity.reach_methodology.
enumDescriptions.devices: Unique device identifiers (IDFA, GAID, CTV device ID).
enumDescriptions.individuals: Unique people. Panel-based or identity-resolved measurement.

items.title: Reach Unit

suppression_constraints.description: Exact supported suppress cooldown intervals, one entry per duration unit.

window_constraints.description: Exact supported max_impressions.window intervals, one entry per duration unit.

allOf.title: Frequency Cap Constraints

x-adcp-validation.unique_suppression_units: suppression_constraints MUST contain at most one entry for each unit.
x-adcp-validation.unique_window_units: window_constraints MUST contain at most one entry for each unit.

items.description: The aggregate MediaBuy frequency-cap control shape supported in 3.2.
items.title: Media Buy Frequency Cap Control Mode

Shared0.description: Extension object for platform-specific, vendor-namespaced parameters. Extensions are always optional and must be namespaced under a vendor/platform key (e.g., ext.gam, ext.roku). Used for custom capabilities, partner-specific configuration, and features being proposed for standardization.
Shared0.title: Extension Object

Shared4.description: Exact supported intervals for one duration unit, declared as either an exhaustive preset list or an inclusive integer range. The two forms are mutually exclusive.

unit.description: A duration unit supported for a frequency-cap window or suppression period.
unit.title: Frequency Cap Duration Unit

Shared4.title: Frequency Cap Interval Constraints

x-adcp-validation.ordered_bounds: minimum_interval MUST be less than or equal to maximum_interval.

description: Optional product support detail for aggregate MediaBuy frequency caps. Aggregate support in 3.2 is max-impressions only.
title: Media Buy Frequency Cap Support
